title: Mochizuki Honami — A Bell Of Gratitude And Blessing〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: A Bell Of Gratitude And Blessing（4★）

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've hung up all the laundry, so all that's left is to see what I need to buy the next time I come here.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (First, laundry detergent, that bathtub cleaner and...maybe some more bath salts.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I brought a pack over a while ago hoping that it'll help give her a way to relax, but she's already gone through most of it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm glad to see that she's using it so often.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, I should ask her about these bath salts when I give my work report.)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, yes. Please come in...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry to interrupt you working, but I'm here to give my work report.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you again for coming today. I always appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's my pleasure. With regards to food, I've packaged each meal in its own container. All you have to do is heat it up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Also...
How have you been enjoying the bath salts I brought a while back?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I chose an assortment based on different natural herbs so that you could choose whichever you like depending on how you feel each day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I use them from time to time in my baths. They all smell very nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?! I'm so glad to hear that...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're actually starting to run low, so I was wondering if you had any particular preferences in terms of what I should get next.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll leave that to you, Ms. Mochizuki.
I've never bought any myself, and I don't really know what's available.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood. I'll think about whether to go with your current selection or a different assortment.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Then, I'll see you again next week.
bgm_area00001
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, no one else is here.
To be fair, I am two hours early.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (As much as I want to practice, first...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I need to choose which bath salts to take over soon.
Let's see. That website I was looking at was...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Hona! I was wondering who got here just now♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But practice isn't for a while, right? Are you doing stuff on your own until then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I was going to...
But there's something else that I also need to take care of.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Something else?
Does it have to do with your contract with that record company?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no. It doesn't actually have anything to do with our band...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Bath salts, huh...?
I didn't realize your job required so much extra thought. Sounds tough.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, not at all.
I'm doing this because I thoroughly enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona!
What kind of bath salts are you looking for?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What kind...? Well, for starters, they can't have too strong a fragrance...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki isn't fond of anything with a powerful scent, so I'm looking for something that's nice and relaxing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be great!
I love those kinds of smells too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Says the person who can never sit still.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, gimme a break.
So, are there any other requirements?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm looking for a set that has the salts already measured out in little bags.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know it produces more trash than the ones that come in bulk, which are much cheaper... But this way, she won't have to think about how much to use each time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, there's more?
Doesn't this ever get exhausting...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, Len, you can't say that...
Hona's doing her best to make this person feel comfortable!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I didn't mean that in a negative way or anything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I've never found this job all that tiring is all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Probably because you're such a nice person, Hona♪ Even when it comes to these bath salts, you said you like looking for the right ones.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, putting so much effort into something that's not directly related to your job seems like a waste of...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Geez, Len, don't you get it?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This Yoisaki person means a lot to Hona! That's why she's putting in so much serious thought!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've already seen Ms. Yoisaki collapse once, and she still pulls all-nighters from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, I also understand that she's doing her best to compose songs that can help the people who truly need them, including those closest to her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She pushes herself too hard sometimes... But I'm just her housekeeper, so I can only help by doing these sorts of things.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
But you genuinely want to be there for her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I want to do whatever I can for her...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Len, we should totally help Hona find some really nice bath salts!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it doesn't seem right to leave without doing anything after hearing that story.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you both very much.
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I actually just found a few interesting candidates.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Lemme see!
